pages.text: The $(item)heavy power cable$() carries 65,536 FE/t, the $(item)power bus duct$() 524,288 FE/t, both lossless. They work like the energy cable: they join cables, machines and cells by themselves. Different cables join too, but the flow is limited by the thinnest piece.$(br2)$(4)Overload:$() a cable offered more than twice its rate in one tick (a transformer, the flow out of a thicker cable) $(l)burns out$().
Run a bus duct from the front of a $(item)transformer$() or from a power plant to big consumers and energy banks.
